Settings.EnabledHint: Automatically consumes matching ammunition from the actor's inventory when firing ranged weapons.
Settings.AmmoModeHint: Choose whether weapons consume specific ammo types (Pistol, Shotgun, Rifle, etc.) or a single generic Ammo item.
